summary: Backend-only review (Jan 2026). Two new admin-only Audd.io diagnostic endpoints (GET /api/admin/audd/status, POST /api/admin/audd/probe) + regression on Jan-2026 fixes (users/search music filter, notifications unread-count). 8/8 pytest tests pass on the public preview URL. No Audd.io quota was consumed (guardrail branches only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4131 lines — should still be split into routers (auth, users/search, chat, moments, notifications, admin/audd). The new /admin/audd/* handlers are colocated cleanly with the other admin endpoints, which is a good pattern to preserve during the future split.
admin_audd_probe uses `import base64` and `import time as _time` locally inside the function; both should be hoisted to module-level for consistency and micro-perf.

admin_audd_probe returns HTTP 200 with `ok:false` when the sample is too small, but 400/413 for invalid/too-large. Inconsistent shape (JSON body vs FastAPI error `{detail:…}`). Not a bug — the review request explicitly requires this shape — but worth documenting in the OpenAPI schema so frontend can rely on it.
seed_data_creation: None. Used admin (admin@nightfinder.app) and reviewer (apple.reviewer@nightfinder.app) accounts already seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_audd_admin.py. It exercises: /api/admin/audd/status (admin 200 + non-admin 403 + token masking) and /api/admin/audd/probe (small→200/ok:false, invalid b64→400, >1.5MB→413, non-admin→403) WITHOUT ever calling api.audd.io (no quota burn). Regression covers /users/search?music=techno,house and /notifications/unread-count. Public URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (or frontend/.env fallback).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 4 probe guardrails and the status endpoint behave exactly as specified in the review request. Backend access log confirms real HTTP status codes: 200 (probe too-small), 400 (invalid b64), 413 (2 MB payload), 403 (reviewer on both admin endpoints), 200 (admin status), plus 200/200 on the two regression endpoints.
